headline: Best-shaped water on the coast today — small but long-period and glassy.
today: The ESE swell carries the longest period around, 0.9-1.1ft pushing to 2ft with light WNW/NNE winds through the morning. That's a clean, glassy dawn session on the log before the SE cross-on shows up in the afternoon. Small, but the cleanest thing going right now — no need to drive though, it's home-break scale.

daysToWatch.note: Up to 2.6ft with light W and NW winds — cleanest bigger day here, though the angle is only fair. Solid morning session.
Prime ESE angle at 1.1-1.9ft with light-to-cross NNE winds. Clean and fun, worth a look if you're in Jersey.
